semantics.machine: Two-state Moore FSM: OFF outputs 0, ON outputs 1
semantics.clock: State updates on rising clk edge
semantics.reset: Active-high synchronous reset has priority and sets OFF on rising clk edge; reset changes between edges do not change state
semantics.irrelevant_inputs: k is ignored in OFF; j is ignored in ON
semantics.output: out reflects current state, with no combinational dependence on inputs
semantics.initialization: Power-up state unspecified; no initial value imposed; tests establish state through synchronous reset

numeric.arithmetic: Boolean state selection only; no signed arithmetic, overflow, rounding, or saturation

verification.oracle: Independent transition-table expected output updated at each rising edge, reset taking priority
verification.coverage: Exercise all four j/k combinations from both states, reset from each state for all input combinations, repeated reset and consecutive transitions
verification.temporal: Check output stability under input and reset changes between edges and after falling edges; sample after rising-edge NBA settles
verification.tools: Icarus v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top; matching vvp; finite shell and testbench timeouts

specification_ambiguities: Clock edge not explicitly stated; standard rising-edge synchronous FSM convention used.
Power-up state before a sampled reset is unspecified.
